source.description:
I need a junior-level Python developer who is excited about building automation bots powered by both offline and online large-language models. The immediate task is to create bots that streamline routine processes for my company and then connect those bots seamlessly to our existing web apps, a couple of legacy desktop tools, and several cloud services we already use.  

You should already be comfortable spinning up SaaS-style back ends (FastAPI, Django, or a similar stack is fine) and have at least tinkered with frameworks such as LangChain, [login to view URL], or the OpenAI API so you can switch between local and hosted LLMs when needed. A solid grasp of common automation libraries—think Selenium, Playwright, PyAutoGUI, or REST hooks—will also make the work smoother.  

Deliverables I expect:  
• A working automation bot (or small fleet of bots) that can log in, collect data, act on it, and hand results back to our web, desktop, and cloud environments without manual intervention.  
• Clear, concise setup instructions and inline code comments so another developer can extend the project later.  
• A brief hand-off call or screen-share so I can see the bot in action and ask final questions.  

If you enjoy experimenting with LLM prompts, integrating APIs, and turning repetitive tasks into one-click workflows, you’ll be a great fit. Let me know what similar projects you’ve already built, especially any that bridged multiple platforms the way this one will.
